primary_information: Originally frozen same-year climate and equal eligible station weighting; retrospective annual estimation. No promotion of best context/forest condition.
main_tuning: Three expanding TimeSeriesSplit folds on all 31 training years; same train-only preprocessing/log target. RBF and quantum families receive 36 candidates each per width, identical C/epsilon grid; choose lowest pooled inner MAE with deterministic grid-order tie break. Ridge has three alpha candidates; linear SVR has nine C/epsilon candidates. Outer-development scores and test scores do not select settings.

selector_crossover.input_budget: Four selected inputs; all-ten is an explicitly different ten-input control
selector_crossover.selection: Use only full training years for relevance/redundancy/Lasso/QAOA, fixed weights and capped calls from annual_selectors. No tuning in crossover. Cache kernels across repeated selected subsets; no test-based subset choice.
selector_crossover.interpretation: Seeds reuse the same years and may select identical subsets. Crossover is a frozen comparison, not additional independent replication or a winning subset search.
selector_crossover.encoding_order: Canonical parent feature order for every selected subset; sort feature indices before all predictor/kernel fits. Ranking order is not an additional circuit choice.

two_phase_execution: Train selects parameters and saves learned model state, training scaling and kernel receipts without test data. Evaluate verifies frozen plan/code/model hashes, creates an exclusive evaluation intent, prepares six annual test rows from source and computes fixed predictions. No adaptive retry/reset or change follows from inspecting errors.
source_cutoff: Woodland 2022 accepted; forest ablation remains training-only and does not supply final model inputs. Do not fabricate future maps.
limitations: Six reused evaluation years overlap a previously inspected incident study; not a pristine holdout
31 training observations and historical station/reporting changes
Retrospective sources and missing availability prevent operational forecast claims
Exact local simulation; no device advantage
No confidence/significance claim from three seeds or six years
test_rule: One new annual evaluation intent in a new namespace; preserve old incident final intent and all evidence. If interrupted, collect available records rather than reset or blindly refit.
